column4: Looking straight down the same bookshelf shaft to its bottom: a patch of coal-dark soil with fallen books and loose pages; clearly separated shelf edges around it; no people.

An underground doll repair workshop opening off the bottom of the bookshaft: a large flat central workbench, many small drawers, old tools on pegboards, spools of thread, jars, a lamp, spare doll parts hanging; a strong clear floor; no people.
